About Eya Printables

Digital products and personalized designs, made to make planning and academic work more elegant and organized.

Planners, presentation templates, certificates and graduation designs share one idea: clear layouts, a calm look and room for your own words.

Clarity, elegance, practicality and personalization guide every design.

Questions

What format are the planners?

Mainly printable PDF files.

How do I order?

Send a message on WhatsApp or Instagram with the product you want. The Order Now buttons open the message for you.

Can a product be personalized?

Some products can, on request. Use the Custom Orders form to describe what you need.

How will I receive my files?

After your order is confirmed, through the channel we agreed on together.

Which languages are available?

Products are available in English and French.

Payment, delivery time and refunds?

Details are shared when you place your order. [To be completed by the owner]
